en.name: Big Wig
en.ability: Each nominee chooses a player: until voting, only they may speak & they are mad the nominee is good or they might die.

revisions.v1: Each nominee chooses a player: until voting, only they may speak & they are mad the nominee is good or they might die.

zh.name: Big Wig
zh.ability: 每位被提名者都要选择一名玩家：在投票开始前，只有该玩家可以发言，且他必须“疯狂”地声称被提名者是善良的，否则他可能会死亡。
